card.name: Punctuation inside written numbers
card.fires_on: Marks within a number that come right before more digits: a thousands comma after a leading digit, a space before a number, an equals sign before n, or an opening parenthesis before a count. Seen in dose, sample-size and table figures.

modes.label: Thousands comma
modes.description: A comma after the first digit of a number in the thousands, before the final three digits.

modes.label: Sample size marks
modes.description: An equals sign or parenthesis or space just before a patient count or table value.

modes.label: Space before digits
modes.description: A space standing in front of a number in a dose or patient count.
